snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Capcom sent over a closer look at gameplay from Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, the third entry in the turn-based spinoff series that has you riding, nurturing and bonding with legendary monsters. Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection is coming to PC and consoles on March 13th.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852190/Monster_Hunter_Stories_3_Twisted_Reflection/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
